identification: Two items: a brass Primus kerosene pressure stove (stamped SWEDEN PRIMUS, model number not legible, probably a No.1 style with cast pot stand and wire legs) and a rusty Primus folding tin stove case with partial B.A. Hjorth & Co Stockholm decal. Common, mass-produced Swedish stoves; worn and rusty.
